text.p: The Italian debt market ended down but off lows after yo-yoing in a narrow afternoon range with direction uncertain and doubts remaining over Italian corrective budget measures and the European single currency.
The June Btp future ended 30 basis points off at 125.67 after trading in a range of 125.35/97. Neither support at 125.20 or resistance at 126.00 was tested.
Foreign bond markets gave no help, with bunds and T-bonds steady after a raft of benign U.S. data but with other high-yielding bond markets lower.
The spread over benchmark bunds moved out to 202 bps.
